detect.title: Welcome to LiraTek
detect.scanning: Scanning for existing shops on your network...
detect.found: We found an existing shop! Join it or set up a new one.
detect.notFound: No existing shops found. You can browse for one or start fresh.
detect.mountHint: Make sure the primary laptop's shared folder is mounted in Finder before scanning.

join.title: Join {{shop}}
join.subtitle: Optionally add staff users for this laptop, or just join and log in with the shop's existing accounts.

account.title: Welcome to LiraTek
account.subtitle: Set up your shop and create the admin account.

baseSystem.title: Choose Your Base System
baseSystem.subtitle: Which system do you own? The other will require a partner.
baseSystem.locked: This cannot be changed after setup.

modules.title: Modules & Features
modules.subtitle: Choose which modules and features to enable. You can change these later in Settings.
modules.openingClosingHint: Daily cash drawer opening and closing workflow
modules.customerSessionsHint: Track per-customer transactions in a floating window

currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.subtitle: Select which currencies your shop will use. You can update this later in Settings.

database.title: Database Location
database.subtitle: Choose where to store your database. For multiple PCs on the same network, use a shared network folder.
database.localHint: Database stored in this PC's app data folder. Other PCs cannot access this data.
database.networkHint: All PCs connect to the same database file on a shared network folder.
database.tip: 💡 Tip: Create a shared folder on one PC (e.g., C:\LiratekDB) and share it on the network.
database.warning: Ensure the network folder is accessible from all PCs before continuing. The PC hosting the folder should remain powered on for other PCs to work.

usersStep.title: Users & WhatsApp
usersStep.subtitle: Add staff users and configure WhatsApp. Both are optional — you can do this later in Settings.

drawers.title: Starting Drawer Amounts
drawers.subtitle: Optionally set the initial cash for each active drawer. Leave fields empty to start at zero. You can always update these later from the Dashboard.
drawers.carrierHint: The shop's own MTC/Alfa SIM line(s). A carrier's starting drawer amount is always the SUM of its lines' Credits — there is no separate drawer field. A phone number is required for any non-zero credits.
drawers.label: Label
drawers.phoneRequired: Enter a phone number for the {{carrier}} line before setting its credits.

complete.title: You're all set!
complete.subtitle: Your shop is configured and ready to launch.
